title: Nara Hotel Main Building
scope: The 1909 Nara Hotel main building with its central carriage porch, dining wing, stepped guest rooms and timber-framed outer walls.
limitations: The model covers the 1909 main building. The 1984 west addition and landscape structures are outside the placement scope. The seam at the newer wing and individual roof junctions are approximate.
The public-domain side sources establish the timber grids and rooflines. Window allocations on less visible faces, elevations and minor ridge ornaments are representative.
